name: io.github.tonyyang0504/huawei_ads-mcp
description: 鲸鸿动能 Petal Ads (Huawei Ads) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pau

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_HUAWEI_ADS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your Marketing API client ID (华为开发者联盟 → 申请客户端ID).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_HUAWEI_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The client secret shown for that client ID in the developer alliance.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_HUAWEI_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: refresh_token from the authorization-code login (authorize with access_type=offline and the ads scopes, then exchange the code at /oauth2/v2/token), see ads_api09.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_HUAWEI_ADS_ADVERTISER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Advertiser ID; required when the authorizing Huawei ID is a manager (经理) account, a service-provider account or linked to several sub-client advertisers.
